content.title: THE ULTIMATE VEGAN NOT VEGAN GUIDEBOOK
content.subtitle:
HOW TO MAKE THE TRANSITION TO A PLANT-BASED LIFESTYLE WITHOUT THE EMOTIONAL WHIPLASH
BY COSMIC KITTY IN SPACE/ANA NOT ANA

content.heading: FORWARD
paragraphs: TO EVERY ANIMAL THAT WAS KILLED AGAINST THEIR WILL, ACTIVISTS ARRESTED FOR SAVING THEM, AND VEGANS ALL AROUND THE WORLD WHO FIGHT FOR THE RIGHTS OF ANIMALS EVERY SINGLE DAY, THIS IS FOR YOU.

content.heading: FIRSTLY, CONGRATU-FUCKING-LATIONS
paragraphs: This required you to face some things in your life that probably weren't easy. Whatever the reason that made you decide to go plant-based (see how I didnt say “vegan”; I did this for a reason)*, you had to confront certain realities either about the wellbeing of the animals, the health of the planet, your levels of empathy, our current food industry, and honestly, how many lies you’ve been told (and maybe had to tell yourself to maintain the illusion of your decision until now)

content.heading: SECONDLY, CONGRATU-FUCKING-LATIONS AGAIN.
paragraphs: The rug of dietary deceit slapped me in the face once I *really saw* what was happening to the animals in the slaughterhouses and factory farms. Unfortunately, that was only the beginning. What was truly horrific was how indifferent people around me seemed to be when I shared this information with them.

I made this guide so you don’t feel alone when you make this transition. You will lose friends, and maybe even some family. The truth is unsettling, and it can make you feel like you’re crazy when you’re the only one at the dinner saying “no thank you” to the dead carcass everyone is celebrating over.

My whole life changed when I woke up to the reality of the factory farm and slaughterhouse industry. My initial research explored solutions to end plastic production at its root while promoting alternative organic-based products (like mycelium and seaweed packaging). However, as I looked into plastic's destructive nature, I started noticing other harmful industries. I started mapping similarities between the energetic signature of *how* plastic was made (violent extraction through fracking and the invasion of nature) and the energetic signature of factory farms, the treatment of the homeless, how poverty is subtly passed on and structurally instituted, the obsession with violence and domination through the military-industrial complex, and lastly, the normalization of modern-day slavery through covert and overt intercontinental operations.

content.text: What happens to the animals eventually happens to man.

paragraphs: There is no point in protesting on the streets to end genocide when you go back and consume the body of an animal that went through their own genocide. No point in standing by Black lives when you participate in the same currency that created slavery in the same place.
As I said above, this was not an easy truth to contend with.

The more research I did, the more I started to hate humanity and everyone who still decided to be blind to the suffering of these animals by consuming their dead bodies. I found it increasingly more difficult to be friends with people who had been in my life for over 17 years. I said no to weddings and birthdays, dinner parties, holiday gatherings; anything where non-vegan communal food was to be shared.

I saw the truth. Why couldn’t they? Were my friends and family really psychopaths? Why don’t they care about the animals? I thought they loved animals. Why are they making me feel bad about this? Why are they making fun of me? I thought they loved me?...

These were some thoughts and feelings that I started to have as I made my transition to a vegan diet. I suddenly found myself alone in parking lots waiting for my family to finish dinner when we ate out.

I WAS SUDDENLY INCREDIBLY REPULSED BY ANYONE EATING MEAT AND DID NOT UNDERSTAND HOW I HAD EATEN MEAT FOR ALL THOSE YEARS. I SHOULD ALSO MENTION THAT I HAD STOPPED DRINKING ALCOHOL AROUND THE SAME TIME, WHICH ACCELERATED THE PATH TOWARD CLARITY AND ISOLATION.
WHEN WE START TO UNTANGLE THE WEBS OF TORTURE AND DESTRUCTION WITHIN OUR LIVES, WE INEVITABLY START TO MAKE CLEANER PATHS THAT GIVE US A SENSE OF RENEWAL.

I’VE NOT HAD ANY DEAD MEAT IN MY BODY FOR OVER 7 YEARS. MY LIFE HAS COMPLETELY CHANGED. MY INNER WORLD HAS COMPLETELY SHIFTED, AND THE DECISIONS THAT I MAKE IN MY LIFE NOW ARE GUIDED BY A MUCH DEEPER SENSE OF PURPOSE AND UNDERSTANDING.
I HOPE YOU FIND WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING FOR IN THIS GUIDE AND THAT YOU SHARE IT WITH ANYONE WHO HAS EXPRESSED ANY INTEREST IN CHANGING TO A PLANT-BASED DIET.

content.heading: THIRDLY, YOU ARE NOT ALONE.
paragraphs: There are countless Facebook groups, Instagram pages, online or in-person support groups, communities, chats, and forums that offer advice, recipes, and support. Even though we are the minority (only 1% of the world is vegan/plant-based), we are certainly not alone or unsupported. I highly recommend finding a community of people who have made this switch so you don’t feel overwhelmed with this change. (Or Join our Discord)

The onslaught of truth can leave you emotionally distraught. Do not let yourself wrestle with this alone. I was 28 when I realized the truth behind factory farms and my role in meat and dairy consumption. At that point, I had over 10,15, 20 + years of being a complicit animal abuser.
Forgive yourself.

content.text:
FACTORY FARMING HAS NORMALIZED TORTURE + MURDER FOR CORPORATE + MILITARY GAIN

TRAPPING US INTO AN ENERGETIC WEB OF CHAOS, ANXIETY, DEPRESSION, AND PAIN.

paragraphs: When we consume products from a slaughterhouse, aka a torture chamber, we inevitably reinforce the very same energetic ties that many of us want to break free from in our daily lives. Instead of protesting on the streets every few months, we can protest every day with the dietary choices that we make. When we redirect our attention and purchasing power to a practice that carries harmonic resonance with peace, non-violence, and regeneration, we strengthen a web that reinforces an existence founded upon these principles.

content.heading: PURCHASING POWER AND THE ECONOMICS BEHIND THE SHIFT

paragraphs: When we consume ANYTHING from the egg, meat, and dairy industries, we inevitably give this industry our POWER. This power gets compounded over time. Ultimately, we have to ask ourselves: which structures do we want to weaken, and which energetic currencies do we want to strengthen? Demand and Supply mechanisms work organically. We know this from economies of scale; higher demand creates higher supply. Therefore, the lower the demand, the lower the supply. This might be an over-simplification of this dynamic - yet how lovely it is to imagine all slaughterhouses and factory farms shutting down because the demand for meat and dairy was not enough to sustain their operations. If you enjoy using your imagination to create the world that you want to be a part of, then I suggest you join my cosmickittyinspace/Ana Not Ana Discord Channel where we do exactly that.

This distinction exists because it’s more important to understand the decision than to use a word that can sometimes be polarizing and triggering. The goal of this guidebook is to make it easier for more people to make the switch to veganism and/or a plant-based lifestyle; not to separate or shame anyone away. This is not about triggering people. People are triggered enough (especially with the current state of the world) - this is about providing such an irresistible alternative that is not only more affordable and accessible over time, but also makes you feel better.

I AM NOT VEGAN. I am plant-based. This means that if I’m in Italy and visit a farmer on a no-kill farm, I will 100% eat their mozzarella and gelato made from their cow's milk and have fresh eggs from their chickens. After living and working on different farms for 10 months in the South before returning to New York, I realized that it’s not about “not eating eggs” or “never eating cheese ever again.” It’s more about UNDERSTANDING WHY I have chosen to avoid the products that come from the egg and dairy industry as it currently stands.
I’ve been on this journey for over 7 years; I’ve realized that it’s more about not giving my PURCHASING POWER to the factory farm industry than it is about being militant toward my dietary decisions.
